warnings: This is a STRUCTURAL roof framing plan (steel hip-roof members with printed sizes/spacing over the grid) — recorded as pattern 'plan' per the primary_rawjson_schema.md §1 roof_plan-vs-plan rule, NOT as pattern 'roof_plan' (the architectural-only pattern). This is exactly the trap the op04 skill calls out.

The roof is an all-steel hip roof over the same 8.20x6.00m (grid 1-4 x A-C) footprint, plus a smaller secondary hip over a setback extension to the south/southeast (matching the ground-floor entry/stair-landing canopy visible on the architecture elevations, หน้า05/หน้า06 — roof slope 35°). All members are repeating/spacing-based (rafters @1.00m) or run the full perimeter/ridge/hip length without individual printed marks or grid endpoints, so each member TYPE is recorded once with its steel_section spec and a descriptive position, per §6a's precedent for spacing-based repeated members (purlins) — the same treatment the already-extracted house 28บ้าน_เล็ก_2ชั้น_12 used for its equivalent all-steel roof.

'จุดติดตั้งเหล็ก PLATE หนา __มม.' (steel connection-plate installation point, thickness blank/illegible on the printed sheet) is a callout with no legible thickness value — recorded with thickness_mm: null rather than a guessed number.
Fascia (เชิงชาย) and barge boards (ปั้นลม) are hardwood (ไม้เนื้อแข็ง 1"x8" ทับ 1"x6"), not steel — recorded with material 'wood', no steel_section.
